description:
Initialization: Sort assigned tasks by descending reward divided by imaging duration, then task ID.

Initialization local search:
- Insert unscheduled tasks in density order; test replacing lower-reward observations, then single-task reinsertion and pairwise reversal.

Reassignment:
- Repair: For broken edges, release the lower-reward endpoint and reconsider incoming tasks and released endpoints.
- Search: Try incoming tasks first, then other pending tasks by reward; test insertion, replacement of lower-reward observations, reinsertion and pairwise reversal.
- Control: Submit one edit per feedback attempt; stop when the edit sequence is exhausted. The runtime evaluates and accepts changes.
